atoms.b: Discuss with your classmates if homework should be banned.

Diallo:
In my ((++opinion benefit)), homework should be allowed, ((++because thus)) it can help students to prepare for exams. If we do our homework regularly, we don't have to study a lot for exams, because we have already practiced what we have learned in class with our homework.

Fiona:
I don't share your ((++view drawback)). I ((++feel hope)), homework causes more stress than relief. ((++Therefore Since)), it should be forbidden. If students don't understand a topic in class, they most likely will struggle with their homework, which can lead to anxiety.

Jackson:
I couldn't ((++agree suppose)) more with you. I also ((++believe scream)) that homework should be prohibited, due to the ((++fact fiction)) that it limits our free time. After school, students should have time for extracurricular activities and hobbies, but if they spend hours doing their homework, they don't have much time for anything else.

I understand your ((++point lie)). However, not only does homework teach school subjects, but also other competences like time management and responsibility. ((++That's_why For_example)) homework should still be permitted.
